tasks.title: pipeline/db.py: Package, PackageEvent, PackageEmail tables
tasks.notes: Research Implementation Sketch data model. UNIQUE(carrier,tracking_number) nullable number for order-level packages; PackageEvent dedupe_hash UNIQUE; PackageEmail keyed by account_label+message_id. Never store email bodies.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/__init__.py: settings, status enum, env keys
tasks.notes: scope+tests/conftest.py (add PACKAGES_, UPS_, USPS_ to CONFIG_PREFIXES). Mirror domains/__init__.py domain_settings(). PACKAGES_REFRESH_CRON default '23 */2 * * *', PACKAGES_SCAN_DAYS 60, PACKAGES_STALE_DAYS 30, UPS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, USPS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET via health.env(); malformed values fall back with a warning.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/numbers.py: jkeen matcher with all checksum validators and weak-validator context rule
tasks.notes: Port of docs/_research/assets/2026-10-10_tracking_scan.py classify(): mod10, mod7, s10, luhn, weighted modulo; named-group conversion; DHL Express mod7 and Purolator need carrier context; checksumless need a label. Test vs every courier's test_numbers in the vendored JSON.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/html.py: link and text harvester with awstrack/Mandrill decoding
tasks.notes: Research Validation finding 4 + merchant survey: keep a[href] (gmail._TextExtractor drops it), percent-decode awstrack.me/L0 targets, base64 Mandrill p=, extract carrier URL params (tracknum, trknbr, tLabels, tracking_numbers, trackNums, nums) and swiship id=. Never follow redirects. Text output must keep word separators to avoid glued tokens.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/links.py: carrier deep-link builder from vendored tracking_url templates
tasks.notes: Deep link per carrier for the page; walmart -> walmart.com order page, unknown -> merchant link if captured.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/extract.py: tiered extraction passing the 20 fixture cases
tasks.notes: Order: sender rules (walmart 555, SEFL Pro#, Home Depot labels) > labeled fields > jkeen > URL params. Exclude order/item/phone/shipment/reference-labeled values. Shopify template by subject shape. Order id capture. tests/fixtures/packages/extraction_cases.json is the acceptance set (carrier, tracking_number, order_id).

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/email_status.py: per-sender status classifier, ETA parse, noise rejection
tasks.notes: Vocabulary from research Validation finding 9 (Walmart Shipped/Out for delivery/Arrived/Delivered/delayed/Canceled; FedEx; DHL ODD; Home Depot; Shopify; SEFL Dispatched/OFD/Delivered; eBay). Substitution/reminder/refund/review/promo mails -> None. Fixture 'status' and 'eta' fields are acceptance.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/inventory.py: upsert, correlation, monotonic status, events, stale/archive
tasks.notes: Correlate by (carrier, tracking_number), else (merchant domain, order_id); never threadId (Validation finding 3). Status only moves forward except exception; dedupe events by hash; stale after PACKAGES_STALE_DAYS without event.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/scan.py: per-account Gmail scan with cursor and 60-day first run
tasks.notes: Reuse collectors.gmail _call/list ids/fetch_messages and health.gmail_accounts/gmail_token_response; query = shipping subjects OR category:purchases OR carrier senders, after:<epoch cursor>; keep raw HTML for html.harvest; store only extracted fields, never bodies. Stub requests at import site as tests/test_collectors.py does.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/carriers/base.py: CarrierAdapter protocol, TrackResult, OAuth token cache, rate limiter
tasks.notes: Client-credentials token cached until expiry minus 60s; per-carrier min interval and hourly budget (USPS default 60/h); 429 backoff mirroring collectors/gmail.py:80-142; status normalisation to the package enum.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/carriers/ups.py: UPS Track API adapter
tasks.notes: OAuth client credentials at onlinetools.ups.com; dormant when UPS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET absent; activity -> events; response shape from UPS docs, kept behind one parse function with typed errors for 401/403/404/429.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/carriers/usps.py: USPS Tracking v3 adapter
tasks.notes: apis.usps.com OAuth client credentials; 60/h default budget (research Q3, third-party figure); strip IMpb 420+ZIP prefix to the trailing 22 digits before lookup; dormant without USPS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET.

tasks.title: pipeline/packages/poll.py: refresh_due() polling UPS/USPS packages on cadence
tasks.notes: Due = carrier in configured adapters, not archived, next_check_at <= now; cadence 2h; stop 48h after delivered; walmart/amazon/order-level never polled; errors recorded per carrier, never raised to the scheduler.
